# PrimaryGames

> PrimaryGames is a free online gaming platform offering hundreds of arcade, puzzle, and educational games designed for children and casual players.

PrimaryGames provides a comprehensive collection of browser-based games across multiple categories including classic arcade games, puzzle challenges, and skill-based gameplay. The platform emphasizes free, accessible gaming with educational value for young audiences.

## Key Topics

- Free Online Games
- Arcade Games
- Puzzle Games
- Educational Games
- Casual Games
- Mahjong
- Sudoku
- Match 3
- Action Games
- Browser Games
- Kids Games
- Board Games
- Card Games
- Skill Games
- Sports Games

## Game Hubs & Collections

- [PrimaryGames Homepage](https://www.primarygames.com): Main hub featuring online games, videos, crafts, and educational content for children
- [Cool Games](https://www.primarygames.com/coolgames): Cool Games directory featuring arcade, puzzle, and educational games across multiple categories
- [New Games](https://www.primarygames.com/newgames): Latest arcade, puzzle, and educational games added daily to the platform

## Arcade Games

- [Arcade Games Hub](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade): Arcade Games hub featuring classic and modern arcade games including Mahjong and Sudoku
- [Action Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/action): Fast-paced games testing reflexes and coordination
- [Adventure Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/adventure): Quest-based games with puzzle solving and exploration
- [Classic Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/classic): Retro arcade, Match 3, Mahjong, Sudoku and other timeless favorites
- [Racing Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/racing): Competitive racing games with speed and checkered flag challenges
- [Sports Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/sports): Soccer, football, basketball, golf, and hockey games
- [Skill Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/skill): Timing and reflex-challenging games testing player limits

## Puzzle Games

- [Puzzle Games Hub](https://www.primarygames.com/puzzles): Puzzle Games hub featuring jigsaw, word puzzles, Mahjong, Sudoku, and brain training
- [Board Games](https://www.primarygames.com/puzzles/board): Online versions of checkers, chess, dominoes, and Mahjong
- [Card Games](https://www.primarygames.com/puzzles/card): Classic games like Solitaire, Rummy, and 4 Colors
- [Match 3 Games](https://www.primarygames.com/puzzles/match3): Tile-matching puzzle games with time challenges
- [Physics Puzzle Games](https://www.primarygames.com/puzzles/physics): Gravity-defying puzzle games using problem-solving skills

## Simulation & Creative Games

- [Cooking Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/cooking): Restaurant simulation and real recipe-based games
- [Doctor Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/doctor): Veterinary, dental, and surgery simulation games
- [Dress Up Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/dressup): Character styling with fashion and makeover options
- [Music Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/music): Rhythm, pitch, and virtual instrument creation games
- [Simulation Games](https://www.primarygames.com/arcade/simulation): Real-world activity simulations like farming and flying
